The exam

ExamAAMI / ACI Certified Healthcare Technology Manager
CodeCHTM
QuestionsUp to 100
Time120 minutes
PassingACI reports CHTM results as pass or fail and publishes no cut score. This course's official-format test uses 70%, the same bar as our CBET and CRES courses.
Lessons60 lessons across 8 units, about 9.6 hours of reading

Exam domains

DomainWeightLessons
Financial Management20%12
Risk Management16%10
Operations Management40%24
Education and Training11%7
Human Resources13%7

How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 100 questions in 120 minutes, at its real passing score of 70%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

On exam day

  • 100 questions in 2 hours, closed book, with an on-screen calculator and notepad. That is over a minute per question; the arithmetic items are few and worth doing carefully.
  • Some questions are unscored trial items. A question that seems to be from nowhere may be one of them; answer it and move on.
  • Read for the qualifier: FIRST, MOST appropriate, BEST. The manager's answer is usually the one that measures, documents, and escalates through the right committee, not the one that fixes the device.
  • Know the formulas and the names cold: variance, ROI and payback, depreciation, the cost of service ratio, the risk priority number, the Safe Medical Devices Act, the committees, the regulators, and the labor laws.
  • Eligibility is checked when you apply: a current technician credential plus three years as an HTM supervisor or manager in the last five is the common pathway. Apply early; the windows are May 1 to 15 and November 1 to 15.
  • Two forms of ID, arrive early, sleep the night before.
